_comment: Justifications for ONE-SIDED twin re-pins (renquant-pipeline#232). An entry suppresses the CI finding for exactly one pair moving from one exact digest tuple to one exact digest tuple, and it REMAINS VALID for as long as the pins still sit at its new_* tuple -- it is an audit record of a movement that happened, not a token consumed by one diff. It is reported SUPERSEDED the moment either side moves again, because it then describes a state that no longer exists and would pre-authorise a movement nobody justified. It cannot be written in advance. `reason` must be non-empty: a justification with no justification is a rubber stamp. Required keys per entry: pair, old_public_sha256, old_kernel_sha256, new_public_sha256, new_kernel_sha256, reason.

exceptions.reason: (supersedes the pipeline#258 entry, whose ef0f915648a6 state this movement departs from; that lineage is preserved in git history and in twin_pairs.json's _repin_2026_08_29 note) orch#1066 (a') primary-scorer artifact resolver: the KERNEL LoadScorerTask's two path helpers (_resolve_artifact_path, _blend_component0_path) now route the config ref through kernel.artifact_resolver.locate_artifact (strategy_dir first, repo_root fallback) instead of joining onto _strategy_dir only, matching the blend components' precedence; a miss still returns the strategy_dir candidate so every fail-closed reason is unchanged. KERNEL-ONLY for the same structural reason as the pipeline#258 lineage: the public twin (renquant_pipeline.panel_scoring.LoadScorerTask) validates an artifact-manifest contract on ctx and never resolves a filesystem path, so there is no call site to receive this change. public_sha256 unchanged and intended to stay unchanged.

(supersedes the pipeline#250 entry, whose 5cf79a1be970 state this movement departs from) pipeline#258 momentum-primary surface: the kernel copy's matrix guard now delegates to the shared matrix_usable predicate (tasks_feature_matrix), which admits a 0-column frame WITH rows for a matrix-less scorer (feature_cols == [], the momentum lookup) — pandas .empty is True on 0 columns and fail-closed a healthy lane (measured 2026-08-03: X.shape=(88,0) → panel_score_matrix_missing). The public twin scores a caller-supplied dict matrix (ctx.panel_feature_matrix), builds no inference frame, and its feature-contract check deliberately BLOCKS on an empty contract — a matrix-less scorer is not servable there by design, so the guard change has no public call site. No admission behaviour changes for feature scorers on either side (matrix_usable requires columns for any scorer with a non-empty feature contract).

orch#703 adds PersistServedMatrixTask to the KERNEL PanelScoringJob only, and NOT to the public twin, deliberately. The public PanelScoringJob (renquant_pipeline/panel_scoring.py) is the intraday/frozen-score chain: it has no NGBoost/GlobalCalibration/Kelly/QualityFloor stage, so the surface the sink exists to record does not exist there; and its matrix lives at ctx.panel_feature_matrix, which _StubFrozenFeatureMatrixTask fills with EMPTY per-ticker dicts. Mirroring the task would write a file that looks like served-input evidence and contains none - strictly worse than not writing it. The asymmetry is the intended behaviour, not an oversight, and the sink SKIPS rather than writing an empty matrix if it is ever reached from there.

(supersedes the pipeline#283 wf-fail entry, whose 0c898b93e0c2 state this movement departs from — that lineage is preserved in git history and in twin_pairs.json's _repin_2026_08_10 note) vol-window license (orch#1004 design, impl PR 1; CONFIRMED verdict orch#1003 under prereg orch#1001): the KERNEL RegimeModelAdmissionTask gains a lane-flag-gated admission substitute — inside the certified vol window (SPY vol20 > 0.135, STRICT, AND resolved non-BEAR regime AND no hard-BEAR override) the top-decile by served panel score keeps buy admissibility in place of the missing per-regime WF evidence; governance refusals (diagnostic-only, wf-fail) are never overridden; every config without ranking.panel_scoring.vol_window_license.enabled = true is byte-identical (test-pinned unreachability + byte-identity, tests/test_vol_window_license.py). The public twin (renquant_pipeline.panel_scoring.RegimeModelAdmissionTask) is a genuinely different implementation — evaluate_model_admission over strategy_config/artifact_manifest/market_snapshot with NO wf_gate_metadata regime-evidence stages — so there is no refusal slot to mirror the license into; the KERNEL-only re-pin is the correct shape, exactly like the diagnostic-only and wf-fail lineage entries above. public_sha256 unchanged and intended to stay unchanged.
